name: Word of the day

daily.prompt: Pick a useful Spanish word that a learner at an intermediate level may not know yet, and not one picked before. Give the word, its part of speech, its meaning in a few plain English words starting in lower case, and one short example sentence in Spanish that uses it. Leave verdict empty; the person sets it.

words.definition: unfortunately, said when something did not go the way anyone hoped
words.example: Desafortunadamente, el tren salió sin nosotros.
